The fallers tell their own story. The Dodgers started at 24% and peaked at 37% before dropping to zero. Cleveland climbed from 8% to 20%, and the Yankees went from 10% to 17%, before both were eliminated. The White Sox peaked at 9% from a 3% start.

reason: Every number matches the facts, and the uncertainty is framed positively as Tampa Bay winning about 1 time in 3, so it is ready to post.
